title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of retro-reflective devices (RRD) for power-driven vehicles and their trailers (version 1.2.1)
scope_summary: R150 approves retro-reflective device types: retro-reflectors (Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA), retro-reflective marking materials (Classes C, D, E, F, D/E), rear marking plates for heavy and long vehicles (Classes 1-5) and for slow moving vehicles (Classes 1-2), and advance warning triangles (Types 1 and 2). These devices are intended for motor vehicles and their trailers, with installation governed by UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 and 86.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective devices as: Retro-reflectors of the Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA Retro-reflective Marking Materials of the Classes C, D, E and F, D/E Retro-reflective Marking Plates for Heavy and Long Vehicles (HLV) of the Classes 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 Retro-reflective Marking Plates for Slow Moving Vehicles (SMV) of the Classes 1 and 2 Advance Warning Triangles (AWT) of Type 1 and 2.
vehicle_categories: L (via UN R53 and UN R74 installation)
T (agricultural and forestry tractors and slow moving vehicles, via UN R86 installation)
applies_to_components: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) - Class IA
Retro-reflector for motor vehicles combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight - Class IB
Retro-reflector for trailers combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight - Class IIIB
Retro-reflective marking material for contour/strip conspicuity marking - Class C
Retro-reflective marking material for distinctive markings/graphics, limited area - Class D
Retro-reflective marking material for distinctive markings/graphics, extended area - Class E
Retro-reflective marking material used as base or background for printed fully coloured logos - Class D/E
Retro-reflective marking material for extremities marking - Class F
Retro-reflective marking plates for heavy and long vehicles (HLV), Classes 1 to 5 (RF/RR)
Retro-reflective marking plates for slow moving vehicles (SMV), Classes 1 and 2 (RF/RR)
Advance warning triangles Type 1 (WT1) and Type 2 (WT2)
Fluorescent materials of marking plates and warning triangles
Means of attachment of marking materials
relation_to_other_regulations: Combines the provisions of UN Regulations Nos. 3, 27, 69, 70 and 104 into a single Regulation without changing their technical requirements (original series).
The definitions of UN R48 apply unless otherwise specified in R150 or in installation Regulations Nos. 53, 74 and 86.
Section 4 applies the general and individual specifications of installation Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 and 86 where they can be verified at device approval.
Colour definitions of reflected light refer to paragraph 2.11 of UN R48.
The 01 series was accompanied by amendments to installation Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 and 86.
Grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps complying with several UN Regulations may carry a single approval mark.
Conformity of production follows Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement; the Unique Identifier follows Schedule 5.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflective device
defined_terms.definition: Generic term for retro-reflectors, retro-reflective marking materials, marking plates or advance warning triangles (para 4.1).

defined_terms.label: Different types
defined_terms.definition: Retro-reflective devices that differ in essential respects such as trade name or mark, characteristics of the retro-reflective or fluorescent material, parts affecting their properties, or distinctive geometrical and mechanical design features.

defined_terms.label: Type
defined_terms.definition: Defined by the models and descriptive literature submitted, where devices having identical or symmetrical retro-reflecting optical units belong to the same type, and a colour change of Class D and E material does not constitute a change of type.

defined_terms.label: Retro-reflecting optical unit
defined_terms.definition: The optical part of a retro-reflector, which may be combined with a filter that cannot be separated in normal use.

defined_terms.label: Class IA retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Independent retro-reflector for motor vehicles.

defined_terms.label: Class IB retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Retro-reflector for motor vehicles combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight.

defined_terms.label: Class IIIA retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Independent retro-reflector for trailers.

defined_terms.label: Class IIIB retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Retro-reflector for trailers combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight.

defined_terms.label: Class IVA retro-reflector
defined_terms.definition: Wide-angle retro-reflector.

defined_terms.label: Class C marking material
defined_terms.definition: Conspicuity marking material for contour/strip marking.

defined_terms.label: Class D marking material
defined_terms.definition: Conspicuity marking material for distinctive markings/graphics intended for a limited area.

defined_terms.label: Class E marking material
defined_terms.definition: Conspicuity marking material for distinctive markings/graphics intended for an extended area.

defined_terms.label: Class D/E marking material
defined_terms.definition: Material for distinctive markings or graphics used as base or background in a printing process for fully coloured logos and markings of class E in use that fulfil class D requirements.

defined_terms.label: Class F marking material
defined_terms.definition: Retro-reflective material for extremities marking.

defined_terms.label: Marking plates for heavy and long vehicles
defined_terms.definition: Rear marking plates of Classes 1 and 2 (retro-reflective plus fluorescent, RF) or Classes 3, 4 and 5 (retro-reflective only, RR).

defined_terms.label: Marking plates for slow moving vehicles
defined_terms.definition: Rear marking plates of Class 1 (retro-reflective plus fluorescent, RF) or Class 2 (retro-reflective only, RR).

defined_terms.label: Advance warning triangle
defined_terms.definition: Warning triangle of Type 1 (WT1) or Type 2 (WT2) comprising retro-reflective and fluorescent areas.

defined_terms.label: Coefficient of luminous intensity
defined_terms.definition: Luminous intensity reflected in the direction considered divided by the normal illumination of the device, in cd/lx (also called CIL).

defined_terms.label: Specific coefficient of retro-reflection
defined_terms.definition: Coefficient of luminous intensity of a plane retro-reflecting surface divided by its area, in cd·m-2·lx-1.

defined_terms.label: Luminance factor
defined_terms.definition: Ratio of the tristimulus value Y of the sample to that of the perfect diffuser.

defined_terms.label: Entrance angle
defined_terms.definition: Angle between the illumination axis and the reference axis, with vertical component β1 and horizontal component β2.

defined_terms.label: Observation angle (α)
defined_terms.definition: Angle between the illumination axis and the observation axis, restricted to small angles for retro-reflection.

defined_terms.label: Angle of rotation (ε)
defined_terms.definition: Angle by which the device is rotated about its reference axis, with a TOP marking defining ε = 0°.

applicability_hints: A retro-reflector integrated into a rear lamp or side marker housing that is not watertight falls under Class IB (motor vehicles) or IIIB (trailers); in a combined lamp, the retro-reflector part is approved under R150 alongside the lamp's own regulation (e.g. R148).

Conspicuity tapes and contour markings on trucks, trailers and tarpaulin/curtain sides are Class C marking materials; logos and graphics printed on retro-reflective sheeting fall under Class D, E or D/E.
Advance warning triangles are covered even though they are carried in the vehicle rather than permanently installed.
Rear marking plates for tractors, agricultural/forestry machinery and other slow moving vehicles are SMV plates; long-vehicle and heavy-vehicle rear plates are HLV plates.
Wide-angle retro-reflectors (Class IVA), e.g. side reflectors with a wide entrance angle range, need separate approval.
Each listed device type requires a separate approval; extensions to other colours only need colorimetric and photometric tests (not for IVA).
Devices that differ only by trade name can be approved with a declaration and two samples.
A device may be approved for installation at several inclinations or rotations of its reference axis, which must be declared in the application.
Former approvals under R3, R27, R69, R70 or R104 correspond to devices now under R150.
